items.title: build-receipt-capture
items.description: Photograph a receipt and store it against an expense.
items.user_visible_outcome: A user can photograph a receipt and see it attached to the expense.

assumptions.statement: the device camera API returns a usable image on the target OS versions

items.verification_plan: Photograph a real receipt on a real device and confirm it renders on the expense.

items.title: build-expense-export
items.description: Export a date range of expenses as a file the finance team can import.
items.user_visible_outcome: A user can download a month of expenses and open it in their accounting tool.

assumptions.statement: the accounting tool accepts the export format without a manual mapping step

items.verification_plan: Export a real month and import it into a real accounting tool sandbox.
